title: Real Madrid vs PSV 5–1: Bellingham Off the Bench Sparks Comeback 🔥 #shorts
description:
Real Madrid beat PSV Eindhoven 5–1 at the Santiago Bernabéu in the Champions League after trailing at half-time to an Ivan Perišić penalty. José Mourinho sent on Jude Bellingham, Ibrahima Konaté and Dean Huijsen at the break; Federico Valverde equalised, Bellingham scored from outside the box, Kylian Mbappé scored twice and Vinícius Júnior added a fifth. Madrid have won all five league-phase games and are top of the table.

title: Evan Bouchard Joins Bobby Orr & Paul Coffey in NHL Record Books 🤯 #NHL #shorts
description:
Edmonton Oilers defenseman Evan Bouchard passed 40 points in 27 games, the fastest in Oilers history (beating Paul Coffey) and only the third defenseman in NHL history to get 40 points in 27 games or fewer after Bobby Orr and Coffey. In the same game, Vegas Golden Knights forward Mitch Marner recorded his 600th career assist in his 762nd game, the 15th-fastest in NHL history; only Connor McDavid (616 games) and Sidney Crosby (704) got there faster among active players. Vegas won 5–3 in Edmonton.

title: Jayson Tatum 41 Points | Celtics vs Wizards 131–116 🔥 #NBA #shorts
description:
Jayson Tatum scored 41 points, 28 in the first half, as the Boston Celtics beat the Washington Wizards 131–116 in an NBA Cup game to snap a four-game losing streak. Boston made 10 threes in a 46-point second quarter and led 80–49 at half-time. Paul George scored 28 and Neemias Queta 21; Anthony Davis had 33 points and 13 rebounds for Washington, who are eliminated from the NBA Cup.

title: Bills vs Chiefs Playoff History: 0–4 in the Mahomes Era 😳 #NFL #shorts
description:
Bills vs Chiefs playoff history: the Buffalo Bills and Kansas City Chiefs have met seven times in the postseason. Kansas City won the 1966 AFL Championship 31–7, Buffalo won the 1991 divisional round 37–14 and the 1993 AFC Championship 30–13, and then the Chiefs won all four meetings with Patrick Mahomes: the 2020 AFC Championship 38–24, the 2021 divisional round 42–36 in overtime (the '13 seconds' game), the 2023 divisional round 27–24 in Buffalo and the 2024 AFC Championship 32–29. The Chiefs (8-2) visit the Bills (9-1) on Thanksgiving night.
